changes.reason: This is the engine acceleration filter, and it is the twin of CM848 0x38760. It computes ESESAC (0x80a292) = the measured speed ESCMES (0x80ccf4) minus the previous pass's speed (0x800048), then stores the speed as the new previous. ESFT01AC (0x80a294) = cm550_signedFirstOrderFilter(ESESAC, &engine_acceleration_first_stage_filter_state); a value below ESFT01MN (0x807a48) or above ESFT01MX (0x807a46) is clamped and the accumulator is reset to the clamp. ESFT02AC (0x80a296) = the second-stage filter of the first stage. CM848 does the same steps in the same order with the same calibration layout: coefficients at 0x408808 / 0x40880a then max 0x40880c and min 0x40880e, against 0x807a42 / 0x807a44 / 0x807a46 / 0x807a48 here. The one difference is the offset-binary accumulator of CM550's signed filter (subi.l #0x80000000 after the << 16). Twin rule used throughout this output: representation-only differences (offset binary, lookup-descriptor pointers) keep a twin, as initializeHighSpeedGovernorGainSet already does; a real extra or missing step or a different constant makes a counterpart. Run every pass by vp44_engine_management_system right after the engine speed calculation, as CM848 runs it in hpcr_periodicTaskSet_fuelFinal after cm848_updateEngineSpeedFromCrankSignal. Nothing in it is output control or timing.

changes.reason: This is the whole low speed governor (LSG). It first computes the throttle deadband reference offset = cm550_exponentialMovingAverage(0x80825a x validated throttle, &low_speed_governor_throttle_reference_offset_filter_state). LSRF lsg_breakpoint_speed is the operator or the datalink breakpoint, and LSAJRFES (the reference adjusted with throttle position) is clamped. The governor runs while FSGVFLST (0x80a8f2) is 11 (the LSG fueling state), or while LSEXFL (0x80daf6) says the LSG is running and the speed is within reference + offset. Each pass computes the speed error x gain >> 9 and passes it through low_speed_governor_error_filter (cm550_signedFirstOrderFilter), clamped to LSFTMX / LSFTMN with the accumulator reset. On the first pass the filter accumulator is preset in offset binary. Then come the integrator reset, the P / I / D terms, the LSG fueling clamps and lsg_fuel_output_clamped, which goes to lsg_governor_fuel_demand in state 11 (the integrator preset vp44_FUN_00025a34 runs on entry to state 11). It touches neither VP44 nor timing, so the prefix is cm550_ (generic). It is a counterpart, not a twin, of CM848's LSG. CM848 splits the work into cm848_calculateLowSpeedGovernorErrorTerms (0x28ba4) and cm848_runLowSpeedGovernor (0x27ff8) and adds jerk terms, gain adjustments, the alternator load fuel and a reset delay.

changes.reason: This is the all-speed governor (ASG). It runs only while FSDSFLST (0x80ded4, the user fueling state) is 7, 3, 2 or 30. On a state change it presets the reference from the droop and sets all_speed_governor_reference_filter_state.accumulator = reference << 16. In state 7 it runs cm550_dzgTimingAndPressureControlStateMachine; in the other states it filters the working reference with cm550_exponentialMovingAverage(&all_speed_governor_reference_filter_state) and keeps coefficient >> 2. It then computes the ASG state terms x1..x6, the reset states, the derivative deadband and the fueling limits into ASMXFL / fuel_demand_selected. The old name is snake_case and does not say which governor. It is a counterpart, not a twin, of CM848 cm848_runOperatingModeSpeedGovernor (0xea00). CM848 runs in states 7 / 2 / 30 / 37, adds the no-load fuel call, the negative reference slew and the deadband compensation, and in state 7 runs cm848_calculateGovernorReferenceSpeedBlend.
